item.description:
A testing pass that fills the three deferred coverage gaps from v0.3.0, plus one production bugfix surfaced while writing those tests. No user-visible feature changes.

  • File-rotation handling fix in the JSONL watcher. The existing rotation handler relied on FileHandle.seek(toOffset:) throwing past EOF — but on macOS that seek silently succeeds, so a truncated or rotated file was effectively pinned at its old offset and never re-ingested. Surfaced by a new regression test in this pass; fixed with an explicit file-size-vs-offset check. Hadn’t bitten in practice (Claude Code doesn’t truncate JSONL streams), but a real silent-failure mode under any future log-rotation scheme.
  • Live FSEvents ingestion is now covered end-to-end. New tests exercise append-then-discover (the trailing-slash failure mode that bit v0.3.0), file truncation, partial-line crossover across multiple rescans, and per-file batching under live multi-file appends. The trailing-slash bug, if reintroduced, would now break tests beyond the pinned regression at v0.3.0.
  • RemotePricing.fetch is now testable. Added a URLProtocol stub and four tests covering the fetch path: happy path parse, non-2xx HTTP, the 4 MB body cap, and transport errors. Pins the v0.2.1 hardening so a regression that removes the size check would break a test.
  • UpdaterModel is now testable without booting Sparkle. Sparkle’s KVO + delegate surface moved behind a thin UpdaterControlling protocol with a production SparkleUpdaterAdapter wrapper; the model itself no longer imports Sparkle. State transitions, statusText permutations, and the canCheckForUpdates/sessionInProgress republish are all unit-tested with a stub. The ObservableObject audit decision is preserved — Sparkle KVO just lives inside the adapter now.
  • Under the hood: test count 242 → 259 (+17). One production bugfix, one small refactor, zero behavior changes for end users.
